name: MOT_TERR_DIM_MEM_FLAGS
description: Territory Dimension Member Flag is the entity that holds the information on the explicit/implicit flags for all dimension members (except for Account Type dimension) and on the visibility flag of the "unspecified" members.

columns.name: TERR_DIM_MEM_FLAG_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier of the Territory Dimension Member Flag.

columns.name: TERR_DIMENSION_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to the Territory Dimension entity.

columns.name: INTEGRATION_ID
columns.description: Common member identifier between OBI, Cube, and TM. The second component of the composite FK from Territory Dimension Member entity. The first component is Dimension Code.

columns.name: EXPLICIT_FLAG
columns.description: A flag identifying if the member is explicit or implicit.

columns.name: ENABLE_UNSPEC_FLAG
columns.description: A flag identifying if an "unspecified" member will be created below the current member during synchronization process.

columns.name: DIM_SUBTYPE_CODE
columns.description: Used only in the case of the Product dimension. The Dimension Subtype Code differentiates between products and product groups. Two allowed values are PROD, and PRODCAT.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_PK1
columns.description: A part of the FK to the Data Source. In the case of a composite key "Source Attribute PK2" is also populated.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_PK2
columns.description: A part of the FK to the Data Source.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_TIME
columns.description:
The time stamp of the last update (or creation).
This attribute is needed by the ETL logic to perform the incremental update of the explicit flags in the OBI DW.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
